<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot see how financial reserves align with supplier updates in real time. This lack of oversight prevents them from effectively monitoring supplier performance and managing financial controls.",
 "similar": [

   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.056,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.\", \"id\": 4135, \"name\": \"Claim information display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4134",
   "similarity": 0.054,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is enhancing its task list interface to improve user efficiency, allowing for better prioritization, drag-and-drop reordering, and real-time status updates—all designed to streamline claims processing workflows.\", \"id\": 4134, \"name\": \"Task list improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4130",
   "similarity": 0.036,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation.\", \"id\": 4130, \"name\": \"Payment history improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "4f3af2fd-e874-528b-a6f7-1719625085d3",
   "similarity": 0.033,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"4f3af2fd-e874-528b-a6f7-1719625085d3\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Claims timeline\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Claims timeline\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Keelwater's Claims timeline provides a clear, chronological view of each claim's progress, helping users track key events, decisions, and deadlines from submission through resolution.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Keelwater's Claims timeline provides a clear, chronological view of each claim's progress, helping users track key events, decisions, and deadlines from submission through resolution.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"rich_text\"}, \"Status\": {\"sta"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is real-time alignment of financial reserves with supplier updates for oversight and financial controls. I checked the five similar items: Shortcut 4129 (completed supplier contact details) and 4130 (completed payment history) address different problems, while 4135 (claim information display) and 4134 (task list improvements) are started but unshipped and also cover different areas. The Notion 'Claims timeline' page (truncated) describes chronological claim progress tracking, not reserve-supplier alignment. No shipped story or roadmap item addresses the same core problem.","verdict": "pass"}
